caption: The drawing contains three stylized deer-like animals arranged vertically on a neutral beige background. The top animal is brown with red outlines and hooves; it has a blue eye and blue, branch-like antlers with small round accents. The middle animal is blue with red branch-like antlers, a red mouth, and yellow, teardrop-like markings on its body. The bottom animal is primarily red with blue hooves and antlers, a yellow eye, and alternating blue and yellow markings running along its neck and body. Each animal is shown in a leaping or running pose, facing to the right. At the bottom of the drawing, above the printed text, is the caption: "FROM CERAMICS AND ILLUMINATED WRITINGS 1773 TO 1811." Additional text in small caps reads: "FOLK ART OF RURAL PENNSYLVANIA. PLATE No. 3" and "INDEX OF AMERICAN DESIGN PENNA ART PROJECT W P A." The composition is centered with ample blank space around the animals and text.
title: Plate 3: From Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
